title: feat(data-objectstack,app-shell): mark the copilot's drafted settings in Studio's properties, from draftChanges (objectui#12725)
body:
Part of #12725
Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/data-objectstack` gains exports (`readDraftChanges`, `governingDraftChange`, `draftChangesUnder`, type `DraftChange`) and `MetadataClientSaveOptions` gains `surface`, per the claim's condition.

Item 3's per-field draft marks: the Draft chip (草稿) and the Source line (「由 AI 副驾在 N 分钟前作为草稿加入」) on a field or a list-view setting the AI copilot changed, read from the platform's per-key draft provenance (`draftChanges`, objectstack#24298, written by objectstack#24395 `2ec6827962`, in objectui's pin `f4755a68a7`).

## What changed

**data-objectstack (published face, Clause-②).**
- `draft-envelope.ts`, beside `extractDraftBody`: `readDraftChanges(resp)` reads the strict draft read's `draftChanges` (`null` when absent, never `[]`); `governingDraftChange(changes, path)` is the one reader: the entry whose path is the key or its ancestor, LONGEST wins, `[]` is the whole body, segments compare whole (never a dotted string); `draftChangesUnder(changes, path)`; `DraftChange` is derived from the spec's `GetMetaItemResponse['draftChanges']`.
- `MetadataClientSaveOptions.surface?: 'studio' | 'api'`, typed as the spec's surface set minus `copilot` (the doors refuse `?surface=copilot` 400), sent once as `?surface=` and only when stated. `MetadataDeleteOptions` now extends `Omit` of it, so `reset()` does not inherit an option its door never reads.
- Contract review is owed (Clause-② yes).

**The write.** Every Studio draft save under `views/studio-design/**` passes `surface: 'studio'`: the app / permission / flow / object / leaf creates, the object, leaf, nav, flow, hook, list-view and OWD saves (15 call sites). The copilot's saves are cloud's and untouched; nothing sends `copilot`.

**The marks** (`studio-design/StudioDraftMark.tsx`):
- Data pillar field properties: the chip in the rail header and the Source block under the field's properties, for `["fields", NAME]`.
- `ObjectListViewInspector`: a chip beside each setting the copilot changed (card fields, title, click to open, group by, columns, filter, sort), the copilot-added elements of `kanban.columns` and `columns` listed with a chip each (draft array compared with the published array), and one Source line naming them (「「读者」「应还日期」 2 项由 AI 副驾在 2 分钟前作为草稿加入」).
- The ONE added read: the hook reads the published layer beside a draft only when the draft carries a copilot entry and no whole-body (`[]`) entry (that one means the draft was created over no published body). A failure of that read costs the element marks only, never the buffer.
- Copy in the designer table, en and zh. Under a minute reads 「刚刚」; past an hour, hours, then days.

## Deviation to note (ruling 3)

The dispatch says to draw only when the governing entry is `copilot`. The marks also count a copilot entry UNDER the key: the copilot changing one property of a published field records `["fields", NAME, "label"]`, and no ancestor of `["fields", NAME]` answers for it, so the governing-only reading leaves the commonest case unmarked. The `domain:spec` pointer (`6254786917`) reads "its answering entry, or an entry under it". The reader itself (`governingDraftChange`) is exactly the ruled longest-prefix function; the "under" half is a separate export. Pinned by `a copilot change to one property of the field marks the field too`.

## Not on this PR (why `Part of`)

- The Permissions pillar's save goes through `PermissionMatrixEditPage` in `views/metadata-admin/**`, outside this claim's file surface, so it still sends no `surface` (recorded as `api`). It is a one-line follow-up there.
- The element chips are drawn as a list under the card-field widget, not inline in its rows: the rows are `WIDGETS['field-multi']` / `FieldsListEditor` in `metadata-admin/**`, outside the surface.

## Tests (at `3667f86c72`)

- New: `data-objectstack/src/draftChanges-12725.test.ts` (pin a, pin d at the client, and a `@ts-expect-error` that `copilot` cannot be sent); `studio-design/StudioDraftMark.test.ts`; `DataPillar.copilotDraftMarks-12725.test.tsx` (pin b); `ObjectListViewInspector.copilotMarks-12725.test.tsx` (pins c, d through the real panel and a real `MetadataClient`, e).
- Updated exact save-option pins with `surface: 'studio'`: `interfacesCreate-11823`, `interfacesCreatePage-11823`, `listViewInspector-11823`, `createAppOpensInterfaces-11794`, `sharedSelect-11865` (StudioDesignSurface), `ObjectHooksPanel.designerRegistryMissing`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.sharedSelect-11865`.
- Families run under the shared lock with `--maxWorkers=1`: data-objectstack tests naming `metadata-client` / `draft-envelope` / the index (89 files, 1056 passed); every app-shell test naming `StudioDesignSurface`, `ObjectListViewInspector`, `ObjectHooksPanel`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` or `StudioDraftMark` (183 files, all passed after the `sharedSelect-11865` update). Full package directories are declared to CI.
- Type-check: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/app-shell` exit 0 after the closure build. app-shell's tsconfig excludes `*.test.ts(x)`, so that command does not type its test files; data-objectstack's tests are in its program.

## Ablation (each wrapped by `ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven by blob hash = HEAD and empty `git diff HEAD`)

1. Shortest prefix instead of longest in `governingDraftChange`: pin (a) red, 1 failed / 8 passed; restored `d307f08c4428`.
2. Drop the `by === 'copilot'` check: the `studio` and `api` legs of pin (b) red, plus the unit legs (5 failed / 11 passed); restored `835222fb87c9`.
3. Drop the `?surface=` push: pin (d) red at the client and through the panel's save (2 failed / 14 passed); restored `6e46bf2630d2`.

## Gates (at `3667f86c72`)

All 0: phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, hand-rolled-comment-mask, changeset-fixed, changeset-presence. ESLint over the 20 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 on `[no-artifact]` findings only (packages not built locally). The first draft imported `MetadataAuthoringSurface`, which the `18.0.0-next.1` floor lacks; the type now derives from `GetMetaItemResponse` instead, and that finding is gone.

## Screenshots

Branch `claude/issue-12725-draft-marks-evidence` (`10f2277ba9`), stubbed `draftChanges`, zh, at 1010 and 1280 px: `draft-marks-field-*`, `draft-marks-field-source-*`, `draft-marks-listview-*`, `draft-marks-listview-source-*`.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 2ec6827962 f4755a68a7` exits 0 (an exit 0 holds in a shallow checkout too), and the installed pinned spec declares `draftChanges`. NOT MEASURED live: no pinned backend was booted in this run.
- The marks show the draft as it was read. A later Studio edit is attributed by the server on save and shows from the next read.
